enrichment.core_claim: Microtubule tubulin modifications act as an adaptive cellular system, and psilocin selectively remodels this tubulin code, possibly underlying psychedelic-induced plasticity.
enrichment.ask_question: Which tubulin modification changed with psilocin, and what might that specific change do for neuronal structure?
enrichment.challenge_question: Since the psilocin result came from BEAS-2B lung cells, how well will it translate to neurons and lasting plasticity?
